newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez sells property loans to Whitehall.
newsitem.headline: Suez sells property loans to Whitehall.

text.p: Cie de Suez said on Monday that it was selling a four billion franc property loan portfolio to the Whitehall Street Real Estate Limted Partnership investment fund managed by Goldman Sachs.

It said in a statement it would also set up a special Fonciere unit for its fully-owned property assets, which are 90 percent rental, worth 3.1 billion francs and mainly in Paris and paying an average gross yield of 7.5 percent.
The asset sale and creation of the unit allow Suez to cut net property exposure to 4.9 billion francs from 14.1 billion. It will sell its property assets in the period to 2001.
